help.goal: Fill a sheet of categories with words starting with the round's letter. Most points after three rounds wins.
steps: Look at the big letter, then fill every category field.
Everyone writes at the same time, so type fast.
Tap 🛑 STOP! the second all five fields are full.
Everyone else's sheet is handed in a few seconds later.
Read the reveal to see what each answer scored.
notes: An answer nobody else wrote scores 10, a shared one scores 5.
Answers that do not start with the round's letter score nothing.
STOP! only unlocks on a full sheet, and an all valid sheet adds 5 bonus points.
